notes.title: Time Attack Mode Update
notes.content:
This was a little overdue but the I finally made a big update.

Just added Time Trial mode for each level. To enter this mode you just need to press the R key or X button on the level you want to play. All the level times will be added up to a total world time.

Other than that, I've made a few small updates:

-Survival mode is just gone.
-Cubes are now faster to push
-Bug Fixes

Have fun.

notes.title: New lightning hazard update.
notes.content:
Lightning is mostly going to be the main show of attraction when it comes the world 4 (the final world). I plan on adding camera shake and some more variations to how the lightning works.

If you have any feedback please let me know.
